title: Your First Weekend at Drake University, Shared as Cards
description: A sequence of essential campus experiences and traditions for new Bulldogs during their first weekend in Des Moines.

cards.title: Unload at Your Residence Hall
cards.subtitle: The Official Start of Move-In
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned time slot to meet the 'Bulldog Crew' of student volunteers who help carry your gear to your new room.
cards.short_summary: The coordinated move-in process for new first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: New first-year students' Move-In Day is scheduled for Wednesday, August 19, with specific time slots selected via email.
cards.access_notes: Requires pre-selected time slot and government-issued ID for check-in.

cards.title: Grab Lunch with Your PMAC
cards.subtitle: First Meal at Hubbell
cards.notes: Meet your Peer Mentor Academic Consultant (PMAC) and First Year Seminar group for a community lunch at the main campus dining hall.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for Drake students located near the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Weekend includes a scheduled lunch in Hubbell Dining Hall at 12:00 PM for new students and their PMAC groups.
cards.access_notes: Standard meal hours for lunch are typically 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM; requires meal plan or payment.

cards.title: Join the Traditions Carnival
cards.subtitle: Afternoon Campus Celebration
cards.notes: Head to the central campus green for games and activities designed to introduce you to Drake's unique history and school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A social event held during Welcome Weekend to introduce campus traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Traditions Carnival is a featured event on the Welcome Weekend schedule, typically held at 1:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students during Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Cheer at a Soccer Match
cards.subtitle: First Home Game Experience
cards.notes: Walk over to the stadium to support the Bulldogs in a Welcome Weekend match, a common first-weekend athletic tradition.
cards.short_summary: A home athletic event often integrated into the orientation schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Weekend schedule includes a 'Welcome Weekend at Drake Soccer' event at 4:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Students typically receive free admission with their Drake ID.

cards.title: Catch an SAB Performance
cards.subtitle: Late Night Entertainment
cards.notes: Visit the student union for evening entertainment hosted by the Student Activities Board, ranging from comedians to musicians.
cards.short_summary: The hub for student programming and evening activities on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Activities Board (SAB) Entertainment is scheduled for 8:00 PM during Welcome Weekend at the Olmsted Center.
cards.access_notes: Late-night programming is a staple of the Olmsted Center during the semester.

cards.title: Walk the Painted Street
cards.subtitle: A Colorful Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Stroll down Carpenter Avenue to see the colorful squares painted by student organizations, a tradition dating back decades.
cards.short_summary: A section of Carpenter Avenue decorated with murals by student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Street Painting is a major Drake tradition where organizations decorate squares on the street along Carpenter Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible sidewalk; best viewed during daylight hours.

cards.title: Find the Kissing Rock
cards.subtitle: Historic Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Locate this 40-ton boulder near Old Main, which serves as a landmark for university history and various student legends.
cards.short_summary: A historic rock located east of Old Main with long-standing campus legends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kissing Rock is located on the southeast corner of Old Main and is a stop on Welcome Weekend scavenger hunts.

cards.title: Explore Cowles Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Hub and Study Space
cards.notes: Take a self-guided tour of the library to find your favorite study nook and check out the 'Midnight Hall' for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library providing research support and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library hosts info sessions and is a key resource introduced during orientation programs.
cards.access_notes: Standard semester hours often extend late; check current schedule for weekend access.

cards.title: Browse the Activity Fair
cards.subtitle: Find Your Student Org
cards.notes: Meet representatives from over 150 student clubs and organizations to find ways to get involved beyond the classroom.
cards.short_summary: An annual fair showcasing student organizations and involvement opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake University hosts a Student Activity Fair each year where students can learn about different clubs and organizations.
cards.access_notes: Typically held outdoors or in the Olmsted Center during the first week of classes.

cards.title: Get Your Bulldog Gear
cards.subtitle: Official Campus Shop
cards.notes: Visit the bookstore to pick up your textbooks and stock up on Drake apparel before the first day of classes.
cards.short_summary: The official campus store for textbooks, supplies, and university merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Book Store is a key campus destination located near the Olmsted Center.
cards.access_notes: Check for special extended hours during move-in weekend.
